cross_source_reconciliation.result: Frozen-head ingestd/app.py matches the inspected Drive semantic implementation for the findings below.

semantic_findings.finding: DEFAULT_POLICY allowed_roots includes Path.home(), making the second ~/aicore root redundant and permitting read_file to copy/process any resolvable file under the Frank OS user's home by default.
semantic_findings.inheritance: Perception/file-read authority must be path-capability scoped per request. Home-wide ambient read is forbidden for generated/agent-originated actions.

semantic_findings.finding: Policy field mode defaults to read_only but is only returned by /health; no enforcement branch consumes mode. The actual policy is solely an allowed-root path check.
semantic_findings.inheritance: Policy labels are not authority. Typed effects and mechanically enforced capabilities must define allowed operations.

semantic_findings.finding: Upload is correctly streamed in 1 MiB chunks but has no total byte/quota limit before writing to ART_DIR; processing occurs only after the full file is stored.
semantic_findings.inheritance: Streaming is necessary but insufficient: enforce per-artifact, per-principal and global storage quotas plus cleanup/retention policy.

semantic_findings.finding: read_file has no source-size/page/object limit before copying and parsing. PDF/DOCX/image/audio processors can therefore consume resources far beyond MAX_TEXT_CHARS, which only truncates extracted text after expensive parsing/allocation.
semantic_findings.inheritance: Input byte/page/pixel/duration/archive-complexity budgets must be checked before or during decoding, not only on resulting text.

semantic_findings.finding: Image processing reads the complete stored image into memory then base64-encodes it into another large string before subprocess invocation.
semantic_findings.inheritance: Retina/input runtime should operate on bounded image surfaces/features or streamed/local file handles, not duplicate arbitrary input bytes in memory.

semantic_findings.finding: Each ingest/read creates a unique artifact directory, preserves an original copy, computes SHA-256, stores metadata and extracted output separately.
semantic_findings.inheritance: UnifiedDB should preserve this provenance pattern while replacing directory-scattered state with transactional evidence records and immutable blob identities.

semantic_findings.finding: Image VLM and speech transcription output is stored as extracted text with engine/provider metadata but without calibrated confidence/open-set/contradiction semantics.
semantic_findings.inheritance: All perceptual extraction becomes typed evidence. OCR/VLM/STT descriptions are hypotheses with provenance, never sensor truth.

positive_controls: Path checks use resolved paths and relative_to containment rather than naive string-prefix comparison.
Uploads stream to disk rather than buffering the whole request in RAM.
Original artifact bytes are SHA-256 hashed and preserved separately from extraction.
Text output has a configurable maximum and NUL stripping.
Filename does not determine read_file authorization; resolved source path does.

frank: Perception access to local files is a capability-bearing act, not ambient self-access to the whole home directory.
needle: Broker file-read/input capabilities with explicit allowed object/path scope and resource budgets.
harness: Add home-secret denial, symlink/TOCTOU, giant upload, giant PDF/DOCX/image/audio, quota exhaustion and percept-provenance tests.
claycode: Expose immutable InputArtifact handles instead of arbitrary host Path values to normal code.
unifieddb: Retain content hash/original/extraction/provenance lineage transactionally and apply quotas/retention.
claygraph: Connect source artifact -> extractor/version -> percept hypothesis -> later interpretation as distinct edges.
gwt: Broadcast extracted claims with source/confidence rather than flattened text.
clay: Dissolved Retina should inherit artifact provenance but remove ambient host-path authority and unbounded decoder surfaces.
